title: Ubp-M knockdown, RT-PCR and ChIP assays
protocol: Transfect vectors expressing hairpin RNAs into HeLa cells with Effectene.
Select transfected cells in the presence of 2 μg/ml puromycin.
Amplify selected clones and analyze the efficiency of Ubp-M knockdown.
Purchase siRNA oligonucleotides against Ubp-M from Invitrogen.
Transfect cells with purchased siRNA oligonucleotides as described.
Introduce a point mutation into targeting siRNA nucleotide sequence but without changing the encoded amino acid.
Perform site-directed mutagenesis as described.
Use primers F1: 5'-AAGGATCCGGAAAGAAACGGACAAAGGGAAAAACTGTTCC-3' to amplify the N-terminal portion.
Use primers R1: 5'-TTCTTTTAGGAGCTCCCTGAGTACAGGAGTTTGTGACAA-3' to amplify the N-terminal portion.
Use primers F2: 5'-CAGAACTTGTCACAAACTCCTGTACTCAGGGAGCTCCTAAA-3' to amplify the C-terminal portion.
Use primers R2: 5'-GATCTAGATTACAGTATTCTCTCATAAAATAGGAGGTACG-3' to amplify the C-terminal portion.
Amplify the full-length Ubp-M construct using primers F1 and R2.
Insert the amplified construct into pcDNA3 vector (Invitrogen).
Verify the mutation by DNA sequencing.
Perform transfection with Effectene (Qiagen) following the manufacturer's instructions.
Seed and transfect cells again 72 hours after initial transfection.
Collect cells six days after the first transfection.
Analyze collected cells by RT-PCR as described (Wei et al., 2006).
Use primers for HoxA9: 5'-ACGTGGACTCGTTCCTGCTG-3' and 5'-AGGTTTAATGCCATAAGGCCG-3'.
Use primers for HoxB1: 5'-TCAGGCGGTTGACAGCTATG-3' and 5'-ATGCTGCGGAGGATATGGC-3'.
Use primers for HoxC5: 5'-TGTGGGAACTATGGATCGGC-3' and 5'-ACGGGTAAATCTGTGGCGG-3'.
Use primers for HoxD10: 5'-GATTCCTTGATCAGTGCCTGC-3' and 5'-GCCGAAATGAGTTTGTTGCG-3'.
Use primers for GAPDH: 5'-ACCACAGTCCATGCCATCAC-3' and 5'-TCCACCACCCTGTTGCTGTA-3'.
Lys cells in lysis buffer [1% SDS, 10 mM EDTA, 50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), 0.1 mM PMSF, 1 ug/ml aprotinin, 1 ug/ml leupeptin and 1 ug/ml pepstatin A].

Dilute lysed cells 10 times with dilution buffer [1% Triton X-100, 150 mM NaCl, 2 mM EDTA, 20 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), 0.1 mM PMSF, 1 ug/ml aprotinin, 1 ug/ml leupeptin and 1 ug/ml pepstatin A] for immunoprecipitation.
Perform PCR reactions with the following primer pairs:
Mix primers A: 5'-CTTCATTCAGCTTTGGGCACGCTT-3' and 5'-GGCCTGGTTGAAACAAGCGTTGAA-3'.
Mix primers B: 5’-CCCAGAATGCTGAGGCGCTTTAAT-3’ and 5’-ACCACCACTACCACCATGGAAACT-3’.
Mix primers C: 5’-TGGTTCTTTAATGAGCCGGACCAC-3’ and 5’-TGTTGCCACACACGGGAAGATACT-3’.
Mix primers D: 5’-TGTCCTTCTTGGCCCAGTCAGTTT-3’ and 5’-TAAGAAGCGGCCAAGGTGTCTCTA-3’.
Mix primers E: 5’-TAGAGACACCTTGGCCGCTTCTTA-3’ and 5’-CACGGACAACAGCGACATCTACTA-3’.
Mix primers F: 5’-ATGTCCTTTCCCAACAGCTCTCCT-3’ and 5’-AAATATCCAGGGACGGGAACCTCA-3’.
Mix primers G: 5’-TGGTTGGTGCTTGAGTTGGGAAAC-3’ and 5’-TTGCCTGGGTATTGTTGCATTCCC-3’.
Mix primers H: 5’-TCACCGACAGGCAGGTCAAGATTT-3’ and 5’-TGGATGGATGGATGGATGGATGCT-3’.
Perform one cycle at 95°C for 5 minutes in the PCR reaction.
Repeat 33 cycles:
For regions A, B, C, E, F and G, denature at 95°C for 30 seconds, anneal at 68°C for 30 seconds, extend at 72°C for 30 seconds.
For region D, anneal at 66°C for 30 seconds after denaturing at 95°C for 30 seconds and extending at 72°C for 30 seconds.
For region H, anneal at 60°C for 30 seconds after denaturing at 95°C for 30 seconds and extending at 72°C for 30 seconds.
Ensure all PCR reactions are performed within the range of linear amplification.
